text:
Nina: quick design check0— mock for compact compare (mobile-first) + desktop table toggle. Two Qs: where should filters live (rail vs modal) and is the version pin flow discoverable? screenshot: <link>
Arun: Compact cards feel great on phones. For desktop keep table as default, but add a small toggle in header to remember per-user.
Sofia: Filters: collapsible left rail on desktop, modal on mobile. Always surface active filters as chips next to the search so you don't open the rail to see state.
Tom: Pin flow seems hidden under a tiny pin icon. Suggest a clearer affordance: a left-aligned checkbox for multi-select + inline pin button for single-item pin. Tooltip: "Pin this version to your catalog".
A11yBot: Badge contrast fails WCAG. Also badges need aria-labels like "Latency p95 38ms". Ensure icons have hidden text.
Nina: Good. Also for performance badges copy should be explicit: e.g., "Latency (p95): 38ms" not "Perf: 38".
Sofia: Keyboard notes: make the toggle focusable, checkboxes announced, and add a skip link "Skip to compare tray" at top of page.
Arun: If we do per-user toggle, store in profile prefs (client + server) so private deployments can sync. API: POST /users/:id/preferences with {compareMode:"card"}.
Tom: UX microcopy: change "Pin" -> "Pin version"; add ephemeral snackbar: "Version pinned to your catalog" with an undo.
Nina: For the compare tray, add count (e.g., "Compare (2)") and a sticky footer on mobile with primary action.
A11yBot: Also verify color-blind friendly palette for badges and ensure focus ring is 3px high-contrast.
Sofia: Decision items: 1) support card + table, persistent toggle per-user; 2) filters = rail (desktop) + modal (mobile) + header chips; 3) pin affordance = inline pin + left checkbox for multi-select + clearer tooltip + undo; 4) badges: explicit copy + contrast + aria-labels + icons with hidden text; 5) keyboard + skip link.
Nina: I'll update the spec and push to Figma. Can someone add a11y checklist to the design ticket?
Sofia: I'll add it. :white_check_mark:
